summary: Short kerb by a junction on a main road with no parking.
reasons: Main road, no parked cars or bays
Painted island and turn lane beside it
Only 22 m, next to a junction

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind the kerb, but the van would sit in the lane at a busy junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Hatched island and lane edge; no shoulder or pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial approaching a signalled junction.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Bush shades the east side; the road itself is open.
